about: Fox-Wizel Ltd. designs, acquires, markets, and distributes clothing, fashion accessories, lingerie, footwear, fashion and sports accessories, home fashion, and baby and children's products in Israel, Canada, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers air conditioning and care products; hats, flip-flops, bags and lunch boxes, thermal cup/bottle, tank tops and briefs, socks, and underpants; and cases, overalls, bodysuits, pants and leggings, blankets, fired, shirts, swimwear, pajamas, dresses, skirts, and jeans, as well as school shirts and writing instruments.
